feature.summary: Web and Desktop show how many files a notebook holds and, when known, the account's file storage used against its plan limit, in the project settings file list. The meter covers the whole account, not one notebook. No per-notebook generation allowance and no notebook export exist.

purpose.what_it_does: Shows the file count against the 40-file cap and the account's used and total file storage on the project's knowledge file panel; the server uses the same numbers to refuse uploads over the plan limit.
purpose.why_it_exists: People need to know why an upload is refused. The brief also asks for a notebook's own generation allowance and a notebook export (S37.39, S37.35); neither was built.
purpose.who_uses_it: Anyone adding files to a notebook on Web or Desktop.
problems_solved: Not knowing how much of the plan's storage is used.
use_cases: Check storage before adding large PDFs.
See that a notebook is full at 40 files.
Understand the message when the plan has no storage.

where_to_find_it: Web and Desktop: project settings dialog, file list header: '<n> of <max> files · <size> KB · <used> of <limit> storage used' (apps/web/features/projects/components/KnowledgeFilesPanel.tsx:225-250; mounted at ProjectSettingsDialog.tsx:414).
Not shown on the Sources tab list (SourcesPanel.tsx has no storage text).
Mobile, CLI, VS Code, Chrome: no meter found.
prerequisites: Signed in with access to the project; both numbers must be known for the storage text to show.
screens_and_controls: Header line in the file list; the storage figure turns primary-coloured at 90 percent or more.
journey: Read the header line of the file list.
Upload; if over the limit an error message states the plan's limit.
feedback_and_outputs: Header text, a full-project message at the cap (KnowledgeCapacityVisible.test.tsx:57), and the server's limit error: for a plan without storage 'Your current subscription does not include file storage. Choose an eligible plan and try again.' (free-plan-entitlements.ts:43).
settings: The plan decides the limit; per-plan values are in the billing catalog (packages/contracts/types/src/billing-catalog.ts:527,617-715).

working: Web/Desktop: list route returns files and the meter in one response (apps/web/app/api/projects/[id]/knowledge-files/route.ts:52,60-65).
Meter sums library media and project sources over the active workspace and reads the plan limit (apps/web/lib/server/file-storage.ts:30-60,77-91).
A failed meter read does not break the file list (storage-meter-matches-cap.test.ts:55).
The cap of 40 files is shown (suite-contracts.ts:502; KnowledgeCapacityVisible.test.tsx).
incomplete: The meter is account-wide, not per notebook (file-storage.ts:30-51 sums all projects of the user and workspace).
Shown only in the settings dialog, not on the Sources tab.
not_available: Per-notebook generation or compute allowance: no code found on any app.
Notebook export: no code found; the founder list says the leaders have no notebook export (docs/decisions/2026-09-27-founder-decisions.md:102-105).

[inferred] Showing the meter on a Free plan may conflict with the Free-usage rule in the owner's notes; to be confirmed.

steps.what_happens: Open settings; the panel requests the file list.
Server resolves the person's plan tier and its storage limit, then sums bytes of library files and project sources.
The response carries files and {usedBytes, limitBytes}; the panel shows the text only if both are non-null.
On upload the server rechecks used plus incoming against the limit and rejects with the plan message.

access_and_usage.permissions: Anyone who can read the project sees the list; the meter is computed for the caller (route.ts:27,52).

access_and_usage.limits_and_metering: Used bytes summed live, not cached; 40 files per project.
access_and_usage.local_mode: Local-only and own-key use are shown uncapped in the catalog because nothing is stored on the platform (billing-catalog.ts:585-602, with doc: docs/decisions/wire-or-cut.md:379); a notebook itself is not available in Local mode.

corrections.claim: Meter sums library media and project sources over the active workspace (file-storage.ts:30-60)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The media_assets part is not just library files. It sums every non-deleted media asset of the user and org, and for temporary chats it counts only chat attachments larger than MAX_CHAT_ATTACHMENT_BYTES. So chat attachments count toward the limit. Project sources count only if the project and the file are not deleted and the file is not superseded.
corrections.correction: The meter sums all of the user's media_assets in the workspace (including large chat attachments, excluding small temporary-chat files) plus live project knowledge files.

corrections.claim: Plan with no storage: upload refused with 'does not include file storage' message (free-plan-entitlements.ts:43)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: That message is returned only when planLabel() is empty, i.e. the tier lacks the managed_chat capability. The error is thrown only when limitBytes is non-null. A normal plan over its limit gets '<Plan> accounts include X of file storage, shared by your Library and project sources. Delete a file or upgrade to add another.' No catalog plan has a storage limit of 0 (Free is 500 MiB).
corrections.correction: Over-limit uploads on a paid or Free plan are refused with the message '<Plan> accounts include X of file storage, shared by your Library and project sources...'. The 'does not include file storage' text appears only for a tier with no managed-chat plan label that still has a numeric limit. Free has a 500 MiB cap, so Free shows the meter and gets the plan message.

missing_facts: The same assertFileStorageAvailable limit also gates chat attachments and chat file intake, not just project knowledge uploads. The storage figure is a shared quota across chat files, Library and projects: chat-attachment-completion.ts:388, chat-file-intake/seal.ts:342.

The meter counts chat attachments and library media, not only project files: file-storage.ts:31-40 (temporary-chat attachments larger than MAX_CHAT_ATTACHMENT_BYTES count). The page's 'library media' wording and its test scenario 'Account-wide' miss this.

The over-limit error text for ordinary plans is '<Plan> accounts include X of file storage, shared by your Library and project sources. Delete a file or upgrade to add another.' (free-plan-entitlements.ts:43-46). The page lists only the no-plan message, and it describes that one wrongly.
